brief: explainer video on how the rooftop solar subsidy works, 45 seconds

context.audience: homeowners who think solar is complicated

concept: Three steps, one rooftop: from the electricity bill you hate to the one you don't get.
plan_outline: 1. Page · the hook: an electricity bill shape with the amount blurred, a red stamp 'Too high?' (3 s)
2. Generated WS · eye · static · a family's flat roof in sunlight, panels installed (4 s)
3. Page · Step 1: 'Apply' with an icon, one line from the user's facts (5 s)
4. Page · Step 2: 'Install' with an icon, one line (5 s)
5. Page · Step 3: 'Get the subsidy' with the figure the user gave (5 s)
6. Generated MCU · eye · push in · a living room in the evening · a father switches on the lights and smiles (4 s)
7. Page · where to apply, the user's link (4 s)
why: An explainer is one idea per scene and a consistent grid; type pages carry the facts so they are exact.
Two generated shots give it human warmth; the facts never come from a video model.
Every number and step comes from the user's own material or a source cited; nothing invented.
